Hero.subtitle: Mallah gives you a structured, AI-guided path into your first tech career — with real projects, a built portfolio, and four specialized tracks to choose from.

Problem.label: Diagnostics
Problem.title: The gap nobody talks about.
Problem.subtitle: You did everything right. The degree, the grades, the effort. And still — the job market feels like a different world.
Problem.item1Desc: Your degree taught you concepts. Employers want to see what you've actually built. There's a gap between what you studied and what day one actually looks like.
Problem.item2Desc: You've searched for answers and gotten hundreds of conflicting ones. Every resource points somewhere different. Nobody gave you a map.
Problem.item3Desc: It's not that you lack ambition. Without a structured path, every hour of studying feels like it might be the wrong hour.

Process.label: Navigation Flow
Process.title: Four Stages. One Destination.
Process.quote: A steady hand on the rudder, a clear eye on the horizon.
Process.step1Desc: Tell us where you are. We figure out exactly where to start.
Process.step2Desc: Pick your target role. We build your personalized roadmap.
Process.step3Desc: Build real projects that prove your skills to any employer.
Process.step4Desc: Your portfolio, resume, and profile — ready to go to market.

CTA.label: Final Approach
CTA.title: Your path is six questions away.
CTA.subtitle: Tell us where you are and where you want to go. Mallah handles the rest.
